title: Verify: Runner locking, timeout, retry, budget and approval gate unit tests
summary: Unit tests with fake agent, worktrees, clock-free timeouts and temp dirs
description: Test the runner with fakeAgent and fakeTrees recording calls.
acceptance_criteria: Lock contention returns ErrLocked and creates no worktree
Timeout triggers a retry and ends FAILED with ErrTimeout recorded
Retry limit yields exactly MaxRetries+1 attempts and FAILED status
Budget stop returns ErrBudgetExceeded before another attempt starts
Approval gating blocks Publish until the record is APPROVED
Report file exists with attempts, cost and status asserted
technical_constraints: Use ExecTimeout of a few milliseconds and a fakeAgent that waits on ctx.Done

steps.action: LockHeld: pre-Acquire the lock path, assert errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked) and fakeTrees.added==0. Timeout: fakeAgent blocks until ctx.Done with ExecTimeout 5ms, MaxRetries 1; assert 2 attempts and errors.Is ErrTimeout recorded and status FAILED. RetryLimit: fakeAgent always errors, MaxRetries 2; assert 3 calls, status FAILED, and Remove called once

Budget: fakeAgent returns cost 3 with error, MaxBudgetUSD 5, MaxRetries 5; assert ErrBudgetExceeded after 2 calls. ApprovalGate: success run leaves AWAITING_APPROVAL, Publish returns ErrNotApproved and callback not called; set record APPROVED via Store.Save then Publish calls callback and status COMPLETED; with AutoPublish true status is APPROVED. Report: read development/executions/<id>.report.json from the temp repo and assert Attempts, CostUSD, Status
